mapper.select: SELECT id, venue_name AS venueName, venue_type AS venueType, location, phone, capacity, description, status, open_time AS openTime, close_time AS closeTime, avatar, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, is_deleted AS isDeleted FROM venue WHERE status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT c.id AS courtId, c.name AS courtName, c.type AS type, c.venue_id AS venueId, v.venue_name AS venueName, c.price AS price, c.capacity AS capacity, v.description AS description, v.open_time AS openTime, v.close_time AS closeTime, c.status AS status, c.is_deleted AS isDeleted, c.update_time AS updateTime FROM court c LEFT JOIN venue v ON c.venue_id = v.id WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND v.status = 1 AND v.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.venue_id ASC, c.id ASC
